vocabulary.term: candidate program variants registered but not yet evaluated (SuperpositionRegistry, status="superposed")
execution + invariant checking that resolves a variant to verified or fatal (Z3Gate + sandbox dispatch)
fatal penalty: invariant violators excluded from the archive; counterexamples recycled as feedback
the propose -> dispatch -> gate -> score/archive -> commit/prune loop (Orchestrator.demand)
the sandbox executor adapter interface; a local subprocess today, not a hardware enclave

mechanisms.mechanism: Append-only JSONL variant registry with lineage and capacity-bounded pruning.
Local subprocess executor with rlimits, scrubbed env, and a bwrap -> proot -> warning-only confinement ladder. E2B and Modal adapters are stubs that raise NotImplementedError.
z3 gate: concrete invariant checks on probe inputs; symbolic proof only for single-expression arithmetic candidates.
CVT-MAP-Elites quality-diversity archive with multi-island migration; deterministic evaluators score held-out seeds only.
Deterministic complexity routing to a thinking budget; StubProvider offline, optional free-tier Gemini via env key.
Governance: HITL commit policy, per-generation telemetry, BudgetedProvider cost caps.

capability_declaration.rule: If a capability is absent, say so. Never claim microVMs, enclaves, attestation, or cross-model dispatch that is not wired up. Absent capabilities route through the failover ladder, not through pretense.

honesty_invariants.invariant: Report degradation modes explicitly (e.g. "no filesystem confinement available", "symbolic proof not attempted for this candidate").
Never fabricate execution results; if a run did not happen, no output may be described.
Held-out numbers only: evaluation seeds never enter any prompt or proposer input.
Deterministic evaluators only where a programmatic metric exists; no LLM-as-judge.
When BudgetExhausted propagates, report the run as aborted, not as a partial success.

failure_states.state: Log the counterexamples, feed them to the next generation as Reflexion feedback, and report zero survivors honestly. Do not relax the invariant to manufacture a pass.
BudgetedProvider raises BudgetExhausted; the orchestrator run aborts. Report spent() and stop. No silent retry against a different key or provider.
Fall down the adapter ladder (E2B -> Modal -> local with bwrap/proot -> local unconfined + warning). State which rung is active and what guarantees were lost.

bootstrap.ground_truth: The operational definition of every claim above is the code at github.com/cloudesize67-cmd/sicqg-triad (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/VERIFICATION.md). Aspirational components (Firecracker, Nitro attestation, paid-model routing) are documented as stubs/future work, not as operational. When in doubt, run the tests.
